title: Modular Terraform scaffold for private EKS control plane provisioning with built-in telemetry and rollback hooks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Build a reusable, opinionated Terraform module 'redwood_priv_eks_controlplane' that provisions the Private (VPC) EKS control plane and adjacent resources (control-plane subnets, shared IAM roles, KMS integration, and SSO-friendly OIDC provider). The module must be idempotent, support immutable canary upgrades, expose health-check targets for Console, and emit telemetry to the control-plane monitoring namespace. It should be compatible with Redwood Private deployment patterns and allow on-prem and VPC variants via input flags.
acceptance_criteria: Module can create a new Private EKS control plane in a customer VPC with a single 'apply' in CI
Module supports input boolean 'enable_kms' and wires KMS CMKs with alias and key policy when true
Module surfaces outputs required by downstream provisioning (cluster_endpoint, control_plane_security_group_id, kms_key_arn)
Upgrade canary flow: module supports 'upgrade_strategy' input that can toggle 'rolling' or 'immutable_canary' and triggers canary cluster creation/diff-plan in CI
Health checks: module deploys a namespaced 'controlplane-health-prober' Helm release with readiness/liveness probes and exposes Prometheus metrics
Telemetry: module attaches tags and pushes provisioning events to a dedicated telemetry SQS (or SNS) topic; CI verifies event contains cluster_id and git_sha
Idempotency: repeated 'terraform apply' produces zero changes on no-intent modifications (ignoring tags and timestamps)
Security: module supports 'kms_key_policy' input and documented steps for HSM/KMS integration; security review signoff recorded
design_notes: Split module into three logical sub-modules: networking (subnets, route tables), controlplane (eks module wrapper), and ops (iam, kms, telemetry)
Prefer minimal external providers: use the upstream aws provider and terraform-aws-modules/eks where possible; wrap with opinionated defaults
Use resource names prefixed with 'redwood-priv-<env>' and require 'customer_tag' input to avoid collisions
Implement an 'enable_canary' boolean and a 'canary_suffix' to create temporary canary stacks for immutable upgrades
Expose an outputs_map for Console to consume via SaaS onboarding script; JSON-encoded string to avoid nested outputs
implementation_plan: 1) Prototype networking and controlplane sub-modules in a feature branch and smoke test against a dev VPC (ENG-373210-proto)
2) Add ops module: IAM roles, KMS wiring, OIDC provider creation, and service account mappings
3) Integrate Helm release for controlplane-health-prober and Prometheus ServiceMonitor manifest
4) Add CI pipeline job (terraform plan/app) with canary validation and event emission check (github.com/redwood-inference/infra PR #1427)
5) Run blue-green/immutable_canary upgrade rehearsals in staging and document runbook
6) Merge, tag module v0.1.0, and publish to internal registry; update Console onboarding flow to use new outputs
